findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "generate_danfse_rtc" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Gera o DANFSe oficial da NFS-e Nacional e calcula os tributos da Reforma Tributária (CBS, IBS e ISS - LC 214/2025) (0.005 USDC via x402 on Base)." → after: "Gera o DANFSe oficial da NFS-e Nacional e calcula automaticamente CBS/IBS/ISS usando as tabelas oficiais MIT da Receita Federal (Base V0073 — 170 cClassTrib, reduções legais de construção civil 50%, saúde 60%, educação 60%, cesta básica 100%, Simples Nacional e transição 2026–2033) no Cloudflare Edg"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
